newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jingwei Textile to issue 23 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Jingwei Textile to issue 23 mln A shares.

text.p: Jingwei Textile Machinery Co Ltd said on Sunday it had received approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission to issue 23 million A shares to be listed in Shenzhen at 4.50 yuan per share.
The company said in a statement it planned to list the A share on the stock exchange of Shenzhen, the Chinese southern city bordered with Hong Kong.
Jingwei Textile Machinery was listed on Hong Kong stock exchange in February this year.
China Guotai Securities Co Ltd has been appointed the lead underwriter of the A share issue, it said.

Net proceeds of the A share issuing would be used in the marketing of advanced viscose filament spinning machines, introducing new models of textile machinery from abroad and supplementing the operating working capital of the company, it said.
The firm recorded a turnover of 330 yuan million for the six months ended June 30, it said.
